scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:worker
scripts.build:worker: mkdir -p worker/public/static/css worker/public/static/vendor worker/dist && cp app/static/css/site.css worker/public/static/css/site.css && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.js worker/public/static/vendor/htmx-4.0.0.js && npx esbuild worker/src/worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --loader:.liquid=text --outfile=worker/dist/worker.js
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:worker && workerd serve worker/workerd.capnp --watch --directory-path assets=assets --directory-path static=app/static --directory-path templates=templates/liquid
